datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on October 31, 2022
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of October 31, 2022, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20221031]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite imagery was processed by the Philippine Space Agency to detect and map the actual extent of flooding caused by typhoons on October 31, 2022. The resulting flood extent polygons and raster maps represent observed inundation areas derived from optical remote sensing data, enabling temporal tracking of flood progression and impact assessment on affected regions.

sources.description: Satellite image processing to delineate actual flood extent from optical imagery during the October 31, 2022 typhoon event in the Philippines
